items.text: The Paris Olympics opening ceremony was a grand celebration of French culture and diversity. It featured international stars like Lady Gaga and Céline Dion, who performed at iconic Parisian landmarks. Over 300,000 people gathered along the Seine River to watch 205 national delegations parade in boats, beginning with Greece and ending with France. Despite heavy rain and initial challenges, such as suspected sabotage of France’s high-speed rail network, the event proceeded smoothly. Lady Gaga performed ‘Mon Truc En Plumes’ in a Moulin Rouge-style act, while Céline Dion made an emotional return with ‘I’Hymne à l’Amour’ from the Eiffel Tower. The organizers skillfully highlighted Parisian monuments, promoting the national motto of Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity . The ceremony was an extravagant display that met the high expectations set by the organizers. Difficult words: grand (large and impressive), sabotage (intentional damage or destruction), fraternity (a feeling of friendship and support). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Paris Olympics started with a big celebration of French culture. Many people came to see the opening ceremony. Over 300,000 people watched 205 countries’ boats on the Seine River. Lady Gaga and Céline Dion performed at famous landmarks in Paris. Lady Gaga sang ‘Mon Truc En Plumes’ in a Moulin Rouge style, and Céline Dion sang ‘l’Hymne à l’Amour’ from the Eiffel Tower. Even though there was heavy rain and some problems at the beginning, the event was a success. The ceremony showed Parisian monuments and the French motto: Liberty, Equality , and Fraternity . It was a huge event, just like the organizers promised. Difficult words: landmark (an important building or structure), equality (when all people have the same opportunities), fraternity (a feeling of friendship and help). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Paris Olympics start with a big celebration. Many people come to watch it. Over 300,000 people see teams from 205 countries. They come on boats on the Seine River. Famous singers Lady Gaga and Céline Dion sing at famous monuments . Lady Gaga sings a funny song, and Céline Dion sings a beautiful song. It rains a lot during the celebration. But the show is still good. People enjoy it very much. The event shows famous places in Paris and the values of France. It is a big and exciting event. Difficult words: monument (a famous building), value (what is important to people), exciting (what makes people happy and excited). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A hydrothermal explosion at Yellowstone National Park surprised visitors and caused them to run for safety as steam, rock, and dirt shot into the sky. The explosion was possibly due to minerals clogging an underground pipe. No injuries were reported, but the explosion damaged a boardwalk in the Biscuit Basin area. Videos of the event show water and debris raining down over the park. Hydrothermal explosions are somewhat common in Yellowstone. They occur when underground water turns to steam. Similar eruptions happened in the Biscuit Basin in 1959, 1991, and 2009. Predicting these events is difficult as they can happen instantaneously . The Park Service will investigate if the explosion altered the underground system by measuring the chemical makeup and temperature of nearby geysers and vents. Despite the explosion, no changes in the volcanic system have been detected, and the park remains at normal activity levels. Difficult words: clog (to block or become blocked with an accumulation of thick wet matter), somewhat (rather), instantaneously (immediately). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A hydrothermal explosion at Yellowstone National Park surprised visitors. Steam, rock, and dirt shot into the sky, and people started running away. No one was hurt, but the explosion damaged a path in the Biscuit Basin area, and authorities had to close it. Similar explosions happen when underground water turns to steam. They are usual in Yellowstone and happened before in 1959, 1991, and 2009. Minerals blocking an underground pipe could cause the last explosion. It is hard to predict these events because they can happen suddenly. Park officials and scientists will check if the explosion changed the underground system. They will look at the water and temperature of nearby geysers . There are no signs of changes in the volcanic system, and the park is safe. Difficult words: hydrothermal (related to hot water), predict (to say what you think will happen in the future), geyser (a hot spring in which water shoots into the air), volcanic (related to a volcano). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A big explosion happens at Yellowstone National Park. Steam, rocks, and dirt fly into the sky. People are scared. They run away. No one is hurt. The explosion damages a path in the park. Park officials close the Biscuit Basin area. Videos show water and dirt falling. These explosions happen when hot water underground turns into steam. They are usual at Yellowstone. They happen before in 1959, 1991, and 2009. Minerals may block an underground pipe . It is hard to know when these explosions will happen. Park workers and scientists will check if the explosion changes the area. They will look at the water and heat of nearby geysers . There are no changes in the volcano, and the park is safe. Difficult words: damage (to harm or make something not work), pipe (a tube through which water or gas travels), geyser (a hot spring in which water shoots into the air). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

US Vice President Kamala Harris has started her campaign to replace Joe Biden in November’s election, just two days after Biden withdrew . Her first rally was in Wisconsin, a crucial swing state for Democrats and Republicans. Despite some Trump supporters, the crowd focused on Harris, who emphasized her commitment to democracy. She has visited Wisconsin five times this year, showing its importance. Biden mentioned Wisconsin in his State of the Union address, and last week, thousands of Republicans gathered there for their National Convention. Since Biden endorsed Harris, she has already raised 100 million dollars. The campaign is moving fast, and Democrats are determined to win. Harris’s supporters highlighted issues like ending the conflict in Gaza. This election is not just about Trump though. It is about who they stand for, and Harris’s supporters are ready to fight for their cause. Difficult words: withdraw (to leave a place or situation), swing state (a US state where the two major political parties have similar levels of support among voters), endorse (to give support). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

US Vice President Kamala Harris started her campaign to replace Joe Biden in November’s election. Biden stopped his campaign only a few days ago. Harris had her first rally in Wisconsin, a state which is important for both Democrats and Republicans. Many people came to see her, and she talked about supporting democracy. Harris visited Wisconsin five times this year, and Biden talked about Wisconsin in his speech too. Last week, many Republicans were at their National Convention there. Since Biden supported Harris, she has raised 100 million dollars. The campaign is moving fast. Harris’s supporters want to end the war in Gaza. This election is not only about Trump. It is about what people believe in. Difficult words: replace (to take the place of someone or something else), rally (a political meeting), support (to help). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A few days ago, US President Joe Biden stops his campaign to be the president again. US Vice President Kamala Harris starts her campaign instead of Biden. Harris has her first big meeting with people in Wisconsin. Wisconsin is a very important state for both parties, Republicans and Democrats. Many people come to see Harris. She visits Wisconsin five times this year. Biden talks about Wisconsin in his speech , too. The campaign is moving fast. Harris’s supporters want to stop the war in Gaza. This election is not only about Trump. It is about what people believe in. Difficult words: campaign (activities which someone does to achieve something), speech (speaking formally in front of other people), supporter (a person who likes a political figure, a sports team, and so on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Portugal, cork harvesting is a skilled tradition passed down through generations. Every summer, workers like Carlos Feras peel the valuable bark from cork trees. It is a labor-intensive process that requires careful handling to avoid damaging the trees. The bark grows back slowly, allowing for harvesting only every nine years. Portugal is the largest producer globally, and cork farming is vital to the local economy. The material is in high demand for its environmental benefits. Antonio Jose Matos, who has been harvesting cork for 43 years, highlights the job’s challenges and rewards. Cork’s unique properties make it valuable for various uses, from wine stoppers to insulation and even aerospace applications. Researchers, like Miguel No at the University of Aveiro, are exploring cork as a sustainable alternative to synthetic materials. Despite the booming business, the industry faces a shortage of workers, with fewer people joining the profession. The long growth cycle of cork trees shows the patience required in this eco-friendly industry. Difficult words: labor-intensive (requiring a lot of work), vital (necessary), synthetic (not natural). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Cork harvesting in Portugal is a skilled job. Workers like Carlos Feras do it every summer. They carefully peel the bark from cork trees without hurting them. The bark grows back slowly, and farmers can only harvest it every nine years. Portugal is the biggest cork producer in the world and cork farming is very important for the local economy. Cork is in high demand because it is good for the environment. Antonio Jose Matos started harvesting cork 43 years ago. He says the job is hard but rewarding . People use cork for many things, from wine corks to insulation. Researchers are looking at cork as a green alternative to other materials. The industry needs more workers, but fewer people want to do this job. Difficult words: bark (the hard outer covering of a tree), demand (when people want to buy a product or material), rewarding (pleasing, satisfying). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Portugal, workers like Carlos Feras harvest cork from trees every summer. They peel the bark without hurting the trees. Cork trees grow their bark back slowly. Farmers can only harvest cork every nine years. Portugal makes more cork than any other country. Cork farming is very important for the country. People want more cork these days because it is a natural material. Antonio Jose Matos harvests cork for 43 years. He says that the job is hard. But he likes it very much. People use cork for many things like wine corks and insulation . Researchers are finding new ways to use cork. The industry needs more workers, but not many people want to do this job. Cork trees grow slowly, so this work takes patience . Difficult words: harvest (to pick fruit or other things), bark (the hard part of a tree), insulation (to put a material on something to keep the thing cold or hot), patience (when you can stay calm and not get angry when something takes a long time). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Friday, a major tech failure disrupted services worldwide and highlighted the vulnerability of interconnected technologies. Cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike apologized after an update to its antivirus software, which protects Microsoft Windows devices from attacks, caused a global outage. This outage led to thousands of flight cancellations and delays and affected banking, healthcare, and payment systems. Although the software bug has been fixed, experts warn that manually rebooting each affected computer will take significant time and effort. Microsoft estimated that 8.5 million computers globally were impacted by the glitch , making it the worst cyber event in history. The UK’s National Cyber Security Centre and Germany’s IT security agency have warned that scammers might exploit the situation. Despite the fix, it will take time to resolve all issues and clear backlogs. It is important to be prepared for such disruptions in the future and have resilient systems. Difficult words: reboot (to restart a computer), glitch (a small fault or problem in a system or machine), scammer (a person who makes money by tricking people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Friday, a big tech failure caused problems worldwide. Cybersecurity company CrowdStrike, apologized because their antivirus software update for Microsoft Windows caused a global outage . This problem caused many flights to be canceled or delayed. Banks, hospitals, and payment systems had problems too. Even though experts already fixed the problem, they say that restarting all the affected computers will take a lot of work and time. Microsoft said 8.5 million computers could have troubles because of the update. This could be the worst cyber event ever. The UK’s Cyber Security Centre and Germany’s IT agency warned that some people could take advantage of this event. This event showed how much we depend on technology. It will take time to fix everything and get back to normal. Difficult words: failure (when something doesn’t happen or work the way it should), outage (a time when something doesn’t work), cyber (relating to computers and IT). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Friday, there is a big tech problem. CrowdStrike is a company which makes antivirus software. This software keeps computers safe. But their update for Microsoft Windows causes computers to crash all over the world. This causes many problems. Planes cannot fly. Banks, hospitals, and payment systems also have problems. Experts fix the problem but it will take a lot of time to restart all the computers. Microsoft says that the crash impacts 8.5 million computers. This is a serious problem. UK and German IT agencies warn that some people can do illegal things. This shows how much we need technology and how we connect everything. It will take time to fix all the problems. Difficult words: update (new software version), payment (when you pay money), connect (to bring together or into contact). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

England manager Gareth Southgate has resigned following a second consecutive European Championship final defeat. England lost 2-1 to Spain in Berlin, after losing to Italy on penalties three years earlier. 53-year-old Southgate managed England for 102 games over eight years. He announced his resignation but called it the honor of his life to lead the team. After the match, he said it was not the time to decide on his future, but now, he has decided to step down. Southgate has had a successful tenure , reaching the semi-final of the 2018 World Cup and two European Championship finals. However, he faced criticism for England’s performance in the 2024 Euros. In his resignation statement, Southgate expressed pride in his players and gratitude to his staff. He hopes the team will continue to succeed and inspire the nation. Difficult words: consecutive (one after another), tenure (the period someone holds a job), gratitude (being thankful and appreciative). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Gareth Southgate resigned as the England manager after losing the European Championship final to Spain, 2-1. Three years ago, England lost to Italy on penalties in the final. Southgate, who is 53, led the team for eight years and 102 games. He said it was the honor of his life to manage England. After the loss to Spain, he said that he needed time to decide about his future. But now, he decided to leave. Southgate was successful. He took England to the semi-final of the 2018 World Cup and two European Championship finals. But many people criticized him for England’s performance in the 2024 Euros. In his goodbye message, he thanked his players and staff and said he was proud of them. He hopes the team will keep doing well. Difficult words: resign (to leave a job), honor (to show great respect), criticize (to speak about things someone did wrong). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Gareth Southgate is the England football manager. He quits . England loses the Euro 2024 final to Spain 2-1. Three years ago, England loses to Italy in the final. Southgate is 53. He leads the team for eight years and 102 games. He says he is happy to manage England. After the match with Spain, Southgate is not sure about his future. And now, he is leaving. Southgate takes England to the 2018 World Cup semi-final and two European finals. But some people do not like how England plays in the 2024 Euros. In his goodbye, he thanks his players and staff . He hopes that the team will play well in the future. Difficult words: quit (to leave a job), manage (to be the head of a team or business), staff (all the people who work in an organization). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Austrian government, led by Interior Minister Gerhard Karner, has introduced new requirements for asylum seekers. These measures aim to integrate refugees better and ensure they understand Austrian values and social norms. Refugees must now perform charitable work for the federal, state, and local governments. They can also work in companies with at least five community service workers, in nursing services, homeless shelters, or winter services. Additionally, the benefits card trial, which provides state support payments to asylum seekers, will be expanded. Those who fail to meet their obligations will have their state benefits reduced. A new catalog of obligations will also be introduced, providing information about Austrian culture, values, and social etiquette . Karner stated that these measures will give refugees a structured and meaningful everyday life while benefiting Austrian society. The tougher immigration policy has already reduced the pressure on Austria’s care system, with a significant drop in asylum claims. Difficult words: integrate (to become part of a group or society), charitable (related to helping people in need), etiquette (rules for polite behavior). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Austrian government introduced new rules for asylum seekers . These rules help refugees learn about Austrian values and how to live in Austria. Refugees must do work for the government or in certain companies, nursing services, places for people without homes, or winter services. Refugees will have to follow the rules to get money from the state. If they don’t, the government will reduce the benefits . There will also be a new list of rules to teach refugees about Austrian culture, values, and social rules. These rules will help refugees have a better daily life and benefit Austrian society. Stricter immigration rules already reduced the number of asylum seekers coming to Austria. Difficult words: asylum seeker (a person who leaves their country and is waiting for help in another country), refugee (a person who leaves their country because it is dangerous to stay there), value (something you consider important), benefit (money of help from the government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Austria has new rules for asylum seekers, people who come from another country and want to live in Austria. Refugees in Austria must do work to help the government or work in places like nursing homes and places for the homeless . They get money and other help from the government. But if they do not follow the rules, they will get less money. A new list of rules teaches refugees about Austrian culture and other important things. These rules should help refugees have a better life and also help the Austrian people. Austria has stricter rules than in the past. This means that fewer refugees are coming to the country than a few years ago. Difficult words: refugee (a person who leaves their country because it is not safe to stay), nursing home (a place for care of older or sick people), homeless (a person without a home). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A four-day wedding ceremony for the son of Asia’s richest man has begun in Mumbai, India. Anant Ambani, the 29-year-old son of billionaire Mukesh Ambani, is marrying Radhika Merchant, the daughter of a pharmaceutical giant . The Ambani family lives in a 5-billion-dollar earthquake-proof skyscraper. The guest list includes celebrities, sports icons, and politicians from all over the world, and the event follows months of lavish celebrations. The cost estimates for the four-day event range from 300 million to over 600 million dollars. While some appreciate the event, and believe it helps the economy and brings global attention to Indian artists, others criticize it as an obscene display of wealth, especially in a country with significant poverty and inequality. Roads around Mumbai’s business district have been closed for the private event, causing further controversy. Difficult words: giant (a very large company or organization), lavish (expensive or impressive), obscene (offensive, rude, or shocking). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A four-day wedding for the son of Asia’s richest man started in Mumbai, India. The wedding follows months of big celebrations which cost hundreds of millions of dollars. Famous people from around the world are attending the wedding. Some people think it is good for the economy and shows Indian artists to the world. But many people are upset because there is a lot of poverty in India. They think it is wrong to spend so much money on a wedding when many people in India are poor. Anant Ambani, 29 years old, is marrying Radhika Merchant. The Ambani family lives in a 5-billion-dollar skyscraper . The celebrations are very expensive, with costs from 300 million to 600 million dollars. Difficult words: attend (to take part in an event), poverty (when someone has little or no money), skyscraper (a very tall building). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The son of Asia’s richest man is getting married in Mumbai, India. Anant Ambani is 29 years old. He is marrying Radhika Merchant. She is the daughter of another rich man. The Ambani family lives in a skyscraper . The building costs 5 billion dollars. Big celebrations last several months before the wedding. The wedding lasts four days. It costs from 300 to 600 million dollars. Many famous people are coming to the wedding. Some people think it is good for the economy and shows Indian artists to the world. But many people are unhappy because many in India are poor. It is not good to spend so much money on a wedding. Difficult words: skyscraper (a very tall building), celebration (a special event when many people are happy), wedding (an event where two people get married). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Shannen Doherty, an actress known for her roles in ‘Little House on the Prairie’, ‘Heathers’, and ‘Beverly Hills, 90210’, passed away at 53 after a battle with cancer. Doherty was diagnosed with breast cancer in 2016, and she openly discussed her experiences, including chemotherapy and hair loss, to raise awareness and inspire others. Despite her illness, she continued to work and remained positive about her condition. Doherty wished to change the perception of stage 4 cancer, emphasizing that people with this diagnosis can still lead fulfilling lives. She had roles in TV shows like ‘Charmed’ and reprised her role as Brenda Walsh in the ‘90210’ spinoffs . Her work ethic and dedication were obvious throughout her career, and she aimed to make an impact beyond her acting roles. Difficult words: chemotherapy (a type of cancer treatment), reprise (to repeat something or part of something), spinoff (a product based on an existing one), ethic (a set of accepted beliefs). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Actress Shannen Doherty died at the age of 53 after fighting cancer. Doctors diagnosed Doherty with breast cancer in 2016. She talked openly about her treatment and hair loss to help others. Even though she was sick, she kept working and stayed positive. Shannen wanted people to know that even with stage 4 cancer, a person can still have a good life. She also acted in the TV show ‘Charmed’ and returned to play Brenda Walsh in ‘90210’ spinoffs . People know Doherty for roles in ‘Little House on the Prairie’, ‘Heathers’, and ‘Beverly Hills, 90210’. Her hard work and love for acting were clear, and she wanted people to remember her for more than just her roles. Difficult words: diagnose (to find out about an illness), treatment (medical care for an illness), spinoff (a product which is based on an existing one). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Famous actress Shannen Doherty dies. She is 53 years old. She has cancer . Shannen finds out she has cancer in 2016. She talks about her treatment and losing her hair to help others. Even though she was sick, she kept working and stayed happy. Shannen wanted people. She wants to help others. She shows that even with stage 4 cancer , people can still have a good life. Doherty acts in ‘Little House on the Prairie’, ‘Heathers’, and ‘Beverly Hills, 90210’. She also acts in ‘Charmed’ and returns to ‘90210.’ She works hard and loves acting. She wants people to remember her for more than just her acting. Difficult words: cancer (a very serious illness), treatment (medical care for an illness), stage 4 cancer (when cancer spreads to other parts of the body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The FBI has named the gunman who attempted to assassinate former US President Donald Trump. The suspect, 20-year-old Thomas Matthew Crooks, was shot and killed by the Secret Service. The incident occurred during a rally in Pennsylvania where Trump was speaking to a large crowd. Gunshots were heard, and Trump was seen bleeding from his right ear, though he was not seriously hurt. The attack also resulted in the death of one spectator and critically injured two others. FBI special agent Kevin Roek confirmed that they are treating it as an assassination attempt. President Biden condemned the attack, called it sick, and stated that there is no place for such violence in America. The FBI, alongside state and local police, is actively investigating Crooks’ motive. The Secret Service released a statement detailing how the gunman fired from an elevated position and was subsequently neutralized . Trump plans to attend the Republican National Convention as scheduled. Difficult words: assassinate (to kill an important person), subsequently (after something else), neutralize (to prevent from being harmful). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The FBI named Thomas Matthew Crooks as the man who tried to kill former US President Donald Trump. The incident happened at a rally in Pennsylvania where Trump was speaking. There were gunshots, and Trump started to bleed from his right ear but was not seriously hurt. One person died, and two others were seriously injured. The Secret Service killed the 20-year-old Crooks. The FBI is dealing with the incident as an assassination attempt. President Biden called the attack sick and said there is no place for such things in America. The FBI and local police are investigating Crooks’ motive . Trump didn’t change his plans and wants to attend the Republican National Convention on Monday. Difficult words: rally (a large public meeting), assassination (killing an important person), motive (reason for doing something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A man tries to kill former President Donald Trump. The attack happens at a rally in Pennsylvania. Trump is hurt in his right ear but is okay. One person dies, and two others are badly hurt. The FBI knows the man’s name. He is Thomas Matthew Crooks. He is 20 years old. The Secret Service kills him. The FBI is looking into why Crooks does this. President Biden calls the attack sick . He says that such things should not happen in America. The FBI and police are working together to find out more. Trump will go to the Republican meeting on Monday. He does not change his plans. Difficult words: former (in the past), rally (a large meeting in front of many people), sick (very bad). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In northern Argentina, a project is underway to support green energy. On a dusty plain in Salta, black tubes fill a large tank with salty brine taken from deep underground. This brine contains lithium, a crucial metal for making electric vehicle batteries. The French company Aramet is using a new method called Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) to produce lithium more efficiently and with less water. Unlike traditional methods, this process doesn’t use large evaporation pools. Jean-Baptiste Ort, head of Aramet’s lithium business, claims that DLE will recover 90% of the lithium, compared to 40-50% with older methods. While the technology is new and being closely watched by competitors, Aramet plans to produce its first ton of lithium carbonate in November and aims to reach 24,000 metric tons annually by mid-2025. This could help Argentina compete with Chile, Latin America’s leading lithium producer. Despite a global oversupply of lithium that has lowered prices, Aramet’s CEO believes the company can still profit. Difficult words: brine (water with salt in it), evaporation (the process of turning from liquid into gas). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In northern Argentina, there is a new project to help green energy. In Salta, black tubes fill a big tank with salty water from deep underground. This water has lithium, which is important for making electric car batteries. The French company Aramet is using a new way called Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) to get lithium faster and with less water. This new method doesn’t use big pools to evaporate the water. Jean-Baptiste Ort is the head of Aramet’s lithium business, and he says DLE will get 90% of the lithium, while the old way gets only 40-50%. Other companies are watching to see if it works. This could help Argentina compete with Chile, which makes the most lithium in Latin America. Even though there is too much lithium in the market and prices are low, Aramet’s CEO thinks they will still make money. Difficult words: method (a way of doing something), evaporate (to turn liquid into gas). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In northern Argentina, there is a project to help green energy. In Salta, black tubes fill a big tank with salty water from deep underground. This water has lithium , which people need to make electric car batteries. The French company Aramet is using a new way to get lithium faster and with less water. This new way does not use big pools to dry out the water. Jean-Baptiste Ort is the boss of Aramet’s lithium business. But Ort thinks that they will still make money. Difficult words: green (friendly to the planet), lithium (a soft silver metal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Manchester United had the worst-ever Premier League season and has experienced significant financial losses. The club lost 71 million pounds in the first quarter of the year, compared to just 5 million in the same period last year. Billionaire Jim Ratcliffe bought a 27.7% stake in United and is now in charge of football operations. Professor Kieran Maguire explains various factors that contributed to these losses. The club spent 30 million on legal costs related to Ratcliffe’s investment. Revenue was lower because they played fewer matches and didn’t progress far in competitions. Moreover, there were also exceptional costs and increased interest expenses. However, Manchester United is still a popular brand, including a new 900-million-pound deal with Adidas. Under Ratcliffe’s control, there are plans for cost savings, including making 250 staff redundant and changing work practices to improve the club’s culture. Difficult words: stake (a share or investment), factor (a fact or influence that contributes to a result), revenue (income generated from business operations). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

England’s Manchester United had a bad season and lost a lot of money. The club lost 71 million pounds in the first three months, compared to 5 million last year. Billionaire Jim Ratcliffe bought almost 28% of the club and is now in charge of football operations. Professor Kieran Maguire says that the club lost money for many reasons. They spent 30 million on legal costs for Ratcliffe’s deal. They made less money because they played fewer matches and didn’t do well in competitions. There were also extra costs and more interest expenses. But Manchester United is still a famous club, and fans believe that it will do better in the future. The club has a new 900-million-pound deal with Adidas. Ratcliffe will try to save money by cutting 250 jobs and changing work rules to improve the club. Difficult words: season (a period associated with an activity), in charge (in control of, responsible for), legal costs (the money that helps pay for the lawyers). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Manchester United has a terrible season . The club loses a lot of money. They lose 71 million pounds in the first three months of the year. Last year, it is only 5 million pounds. A rich man named Jim Ratcliffe buys part of the club. He is now responsible for many things in the club. The club loses money for many reasons. They spend 30 million pounds on costs for Ratcliffe’s lawyers. They make less money because they play fewer matches and do not do well in competitions . But Manchester United is still a famous club. They have a new deal with Adidas. It is worth 900 million pounds. Ratcliffe will try to save more money. He plans to cut 250 jobs and change work rules to make the club better. Difficult words: season (time during which an activity happens), competition (a game or match to win a prize), worth (for how much money you can buy something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The first 2024 presidential debate between Donald Trump and Joe Biden was disastrous for Biden. At 81, Biden often appeared confused, while 78-year-old Trump seemed more collected . Voters and the Democratic Party noticed Biden’s poor performance, and there is now speculation about other potential candidates. Biden insists he will stay in the race; however, many believe he should step aside. Elizabeth Holtzman, a former Democratic Congresswoman, suggests that the party is giving Biden time to decide himself. If he can’t convince Americans of his fitness for office, more politicians will call for his replacement. Possible candidates include Vice President Kamala Harris, California Governor Gavin Newsom, and Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer. Holtzman believes that if Biden cannot reassure voters, other Democratic candidates could energize the race and defeat Trump. Although Trump also has issues with mental fitness, the Democratic Party needs a strong candidate to counter him. Holtzman thinks governors with experience in handling large problems could step in effectively. Mount Everest’s highest camp is covered in garbage that will take years to clean, according to a Sherpa who led a cleanup team. Since the first ascent in 1953, many climbers have left trash behind. The Nepal government-funded team removed 11 tons of garbage, four dead bodies, and a skeleton during this year’s climbing season. Ang Babu Sherpa, the team leader, estimates there might be 40-50 tons of garbage still at South Col, the last camp before the summit. The trash includes old tents, food packaging, gas cartridges , oxygen bottles, and ropes. The garbage is layered and frozen at 8,000 meters altitude . Although recent rules and awareness have reduced new garbage, most of the trash is from older expeditions. Cleaning is difficult due to harsh weather, low oxygen levels, and the garbage frozen in ice. Of the 11 tons removed, three were decomposable and taken to nearby villages, while eight were transported to Kathmandu for recycling. The oldest item found was a battery from 1957. Difficult words: cartridge (a type of container), altitude (height above sea level), decomposable (able to break down naturally). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

More than 3,000 people gathered in Barcelona to protest against mass tourism . Demonstrations have already happened in the Canary Islands and Mallorca, but now they have reached Spain’s most visited city. Over 150 organizations and social movements joined the protests, with some symbolically sealing off hotels and restaurant terraces. The protesters demanded actions to reduce tourism before the summer season, which is expected to break records in Barcelona and Catalonia. According to some protesters, the city should prioritize fairer economic models by decreasing tourism. Barcelona receives around 32 million visitors annually, many arriving on cruise ships. The city council plans to increase the tourist tax to 4 euros per person from October. Additionally, they announced a plan to eliminate around 10,000 tourist flat licenses over the next five years to deal with the housing crisis and prioritize residential use over tourism. There is a global trend of cities combating the negative effects of mass tourism on local life. Difficult words: mass tourism (the movement of a large number of organized tourists to popular holiday destinations), symbolically (in a way that represents something else), combat (to fight). Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is utilizing drones in collaboration with startup Morfo for an innovative reforestation initiative . Launched as a partnership between the city hall and Morfo, the project aims to accelerate reforestation in challenging terrains. The initiative involves drones dispersing seeds of local native species in areas identified through soil and native species analysis. AI-powered computers determine specific targets and seed quantities. This high-tech approach not only speeds up reforestation but also eliminates the need for nurturing seedlings for months and transporting them to planting sites. Greece has introduced a six-day work week starting July 1 due to staff shortages in various sectors. The new law allows employers to require up to two extra unpaid hours daily in exchange for more free time later, although this additional work is supposedly voluntary. In reality, many workers are forced to work longer hours without compensation. Greek authorities rarely enforce labor laws, and the conservative government prioritizes business needs over workers’ rights. Greek workers already work the longest hours in Europe, averaging 41 hours per week, but with low pay. The new law will allow many sectors to require a six-day work week with a 40% wage supplement for the sixth day. Critics argue this gives employers too much power and undermines workers’ rights, leading to increased safety risks and poor working conditions. Many Greeks look for work abroad or avoid certain sectors like tourism due to harsh conditions. The law is part of broader labor reforms a ddressing a shrinking population and a shortage of skilled workers. Difficult words: shortage (not enough of something or someone), prioritize (to make something more important than other things), address (to deal with an issue or problem). You can watch the video news lower on this page.
